== English introductory product comparison ==
The 27 November 1996 FAQ explains that each listed character gains +2, while the 1998 Glossary supplies the complete revised Light Side wording. Its replacement omits the printed ‘on Death Star’ condition. Both marked PC forms use this Decipher wording. The Dark Side text that requires two ability to control Death Star sites is retained. Printed Force icons, location icons and uniqueness agree.
